info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Card By Param1-spec
info.description: The Card Authorization Retrieval API allows users to fetch card authorization details by a specified parameter. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and developers who need to verify card transactions against particular criteria. By providing 'param1', consumers can gain insightful information regarding card usage and authorization status. Typical use cases include transaction monitoring, fraud detection, and compliance reporting. This API ensures secure and efficient retrieval of important financial data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the authorization details for a specific card identified by its unique ID. Use this to check the current status and other related information pertaining to the authorization of the card.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the authorization details for the specified card. Ensure that you provide the necessary parameters as outlined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested card authorization details.
